svg.title: A ground station that restarts with another configuration
svg.desc: The vehicle runs A, matched with another station. This station restarts using C. It drops and counts the vehicle's data, since the beacon says A. Its CONNECT with C does not match and changes nothing on the vehicle. The operator loads A; data is still dropped until a beacon with A and the flag clear is heard, then the station is matched for listening and reads with A. Its own CONNECT with A matches it for commanding.

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold

svg.text: A ground station that restarts with another configuration

svg.text: [any] layout never changes (beacon, CONNECT, RESTART_ARM, RESTART, their answers): dotted line

text.style: font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px

svg.text: Arrowhead: read or acted on. Cross: dropped and counted, or not acted on. The words at each end say which.
